verdict.rationale: Asana is a paid SaaS product, so whether a plan has a minimum seat count or requires annual billing is a fair pre-purchase question. Nothing in the evidence pack covers pricing, seat minimums, or billing terms. The developer sandbox's 'limited users' and the Stripe subscription integration are unrelated features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know whether my plan enforces a minimum seat count or annual billing commitment before I subscribe
